summary: Map kit: smaller stairs and no overlapping map objects
author: client
body:
Goal (user, 2026-11-24): "Make the stairs smaller and try not to allow overlap of map objects".

Done-when: stairs about two thirds of current height; icons placed with gap-based nudging instead of drop-when-covered; zero intersecting icon rects (clusters excepted); kit rebuilt, ink unchanged; previews checked.
